prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
No kind of change can be called helpful yet, as no tests have won.
'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 3 tests.
Evidence is still thin for 'adoption, redesign', 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', 'sign_in, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder' changes, as their tests either lack a second trial or disagree on effect.
Predictions have mostly been too high compared to noise-corrected measurements, though rounds 7, 8, and 9 were underestimated.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -0.6% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +3.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -0.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, redesign: -3.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -6.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] story_video_overview_redesign: Redesign the story screen into a spotlight layout featuring an animated video preview of pet desktop interactions. (why: High mean time (514s) and 23.8% drop-off at choose_path indicates users stall early; visually demonstrating the pet in action upfront boosts conversion.)
1: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_benefit_checklist_hint: Display a hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in saves pet memory across computer reboots and updates. (why: 8 support tickets cited pets missing or resetting after signing in again, and 27.1% of users drop off at sign_in.)
2: [adoption, redesign] pick_friend_grid_layout_redesign: Rebuild the pet selection screen into a multi-column grid layout with popular choice badges for faster browsing. (why: Adoption has the biggest funnel drop (39.1% drop-off, median 89s), showing that choosing a companion is a major friction point.)
3: [adoption, wait_info] photo_upload_wait_info_tips: Add a tip carousel component during photo upload to guide users on lighting and angles for custom pet generation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results, while adoption takes mean 1017s.)
4: [home, new_flow] waiting_screen_interactive_flow: Enable progress bars, time estimates, and background notification triggers while the pet assets render. (why: The waiting phase on the home step averages 2336 seconds and loses 18.7% of users while processing assets.)
5: [choose_path, incentive] choose_path_time_estimate_incentive: Display a quick setup time estimate and highlight badge on the path selection screen. (why: Users take a mean time of 514s at path selection; showing it takes under 2 minutes sets expectations and reduces abandonment.)
6: [finish, layout] finish_home_intro_checklist_layout: Switch home_intro to a checklist layout showing key first-day actions (drag pet, open controls, feed pet). (why: 35.2% drop at finish step (mean 5815s) and multiple support tickets regarding post-onboarding confusion.)

Strong evidence from 8 support tickets and 27.1% drop-off; low-cost hint display.
Adoption has highest drop (39.1%); single prior redesign test showed positive lift (+3%).
Target step has highest drop-off (39.1%), supported by 3 support tickets on generation issues.
